context: A father and his excited son talk about an upcoming Shinkansen trip
purpose: Teach: 宿泊/入場/新幹線/来日/訪れる/治安/地帯/豪華

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、来週ついに新幹線に乗れるんだよね！もう待ちきれないよ。
lines.en: Dad, we finally get to ride the Shinkansen next week! I can't wait anymore.
lines.style: Bright, bouncing tone, voice cracking with childlike excitement throughout

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだぞ。京都駅に着いたら、まず宿泊するホテルに荷物を置きに行こうな。
lines.en: That's right. Once we arrive at Kyoto Station, we'll first drop our luggage at the hotel where we're staying.
lines.style: Warm fatherly delivery, calm and patient, slight smile audible in voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえ、ホテルって豪華なところ？プールとかある？
lines.en: Hey, is it a fancy hotel? Does it have a pool or anything?
lines.style: Eager, rapid-fire questions, rising pitch on every sentence

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: まあまあ豪華だぞ。それより、お母さんが楽しみにしてる清水寺も訪れる予定だからな。
lines.en: It's reasonably fancy. More importantly, we're also planning to visit Kiyomizu Temple, which your mother is looking forward to.
lines.style: Gentle teasing chuckle, then shifts to informative explanatory tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お寺って入場料いるの？子供は安いのかな？
lines.en: Do temples charge admission? Is it cheaper for kids?
lines.style: Curious, thoughtful pause mid-sentence, slightly more grounded

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 子供は半額くらいだったかな。日本は治安もいいし、観光地帯でも安心して歩けるから、いっぱい歩こうな。
lines.en: I think kids are about half price. Japan is safe, and even in the tourist areas you can walk around without worry, so let's walk a lot.
lines.style: Reassuring, paternal warmth, steady reflective pacing

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった！あ、そういえばクラスのケンくんのいとこが来日するんだって。京都で会えるかも！
lines.en: Yes! Oh, by the way, my classmate Ken's cousin is coming to Japan. Maybe we'll meet him in Kyoto!
lines.style: Sudden burst of remembered excitement, voice jumping in pitch

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: それは楽しい偶然だな。じゃあ、明日一緒に新幹線の切符を取りに行こう。
lines.en: What a fun coincidence. Alright, let's go pick up the Shinkansen tickets together tomorrow.
lines.style: Affectionate closing tone, smiling and decisive, soft warm finish
